rounds.text: The market is flashing clear distress signals, with the stock sitting a mere 6% to 8% of the way up its 52-week range and trading down 41.2% from its 52-week high [E5, E48, E49]. Price momentum is deeply negative, reflected in a 1-year share price return of -21.6%, a weak relative-strength rating of 25, and a technical position strictly below both the 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E25, E50, E51]. Institutional behavior confirms this lack of confidence, as domestic institutions have slashed their holdings from 6.71% in September 2023 down to just 0.59% in June 2026 [E43]. Furthermore, fundamental headwinds are emerging as earnings growth decelerates, annual operating-margin trends are deemed inconsistent over the last year, and quarterly operating margins have contracted by 1 percentage point year-over-year [E32, E33, E68]. Conceded: the company maintains high historical returns on capital and equity alongside strong 5-year profit growth [E10, E13, E19]. Ultimately, the rules-based screen registers a low-confidence neutral score of only 58 out of 100, mirroring the severe cyclicality and severe historical drawdowns of up to -73.5% that warn against ignoring these persistent downside pressures [E53, E58, E63].
